Subject: Hero quotes + 1-pager assets for LumaHealth sales materials

Hi team,

We just closed the LumaHealth expansion and the AE asked if we can produce a tight 1‑pager + 2–3 short customer quotes we can use in the upcoming Q2 sales deck and one-pager library. Want to collect everything centrally so Sales and Growth can pick soundbites quickly.

Ask: can each of you contribute the following by EOD Apr 12?
- Marissa: a one-pager draft (focus: problem, solution, 3 metrics, one quote)
- Monica: any existing assets or previous quotes we have from LumaHealth + legal consent status
- Rishi: help secure 1–2 short on-record quotes from the customer (social-friendly length, ~12–20 words) and confirm permission to publish (email consent ok)
- Dylan: hold for design once we have copy + logo + consent

I've attached a template and a metrics extract we pulled from the deployment report to make this faster. If anyone needs me to take ownership of outreach, I can step in.

Thanks — Kim

--

Thanks Kim — happy to own the one-pager. Quick questions:
- Which metric set should be front-and-center? I see usage (API calls/day), latency improvements, and a cost delta vs baseline. My preference is: 1) 3x reduction in inference cost per conversation, 2) 40% lower p95 latency, 3) 2.5x throughput improvement (peak).
- Do we want a customer logo lockup? If legal requires form, that will add time; otherwise we can include a "logo pending" placeholder.

I attached a CSV with the key metric extracts and a rough outline. I'll draft the page with two headline quotes: one short (12–15 words) and one longer (25–30 words).

Attachment: luma_metrics_extract.csv (metrics snippet)

Hi Danielle — great working with you on the expansion. We're putting together a short one-pager and a couple of slides for our sales kit and wondered if you could help with: 1) a short on‑record sentence we can use as a quote (12–20 words), and 2) confirmation that LumaHealth is okay with Redwood publishing the quote and logo. Email confirmation is fine, or if you prefer we can send a one‑click consent PDF.

Two suggested short quotes you can pick/edit:
- "Redwood cut our inference costs and made scaling reminders affordable across all clinics."
- "We saw faster responses and lower bills after switching to Redwood Inference."

If you prefer, feel free to write something in your own words — anything short is helpful. Thanks!

Best,
